name: mirage
text: Built the guard (engine/ThinFair), covering both engine bets and bids. With no sharp book in the fair, an order is refused when the fair rests on 3 or fewer companies and either all are small, or one is large and the odds are identical. Two or more large brands (DraftKings, FanDuel, Caesars, bet365 and the like) pass even if their odds match. The Kambi group counts as small. Sister sites already count as one company. Outliers and stale books were already excluded from every fair calc in the app and engine (BadOdds, on by default), so that part needed no change. Held-back bets will show 'the fair rests on...' in the trade pass. It goes live when the engine next restarts on the new code; tests pass and full suite is running now.
